profile.headline: SEO/SEM Specialist | Multi-Channel Acquisition & Lifecycle Strategy Expert
profile.summary: Expert in Local SEO, PPC, and digital marketing with a background in web design. Specialized in marketing solutions for performance, business growth, and roi.

positions.title: Paid Media/Web Dev
positions.description:
-Enhanced web development processes to new lightning fast turnover rates
-Increased impression share and SEM metrics to personal new records of 50% impression share and 21% clickthrough rate with optimized budget.
-Fulfill a portfolio of 20 Google Ad accounts, 50 programmatic ad campaigns, and 15 social ad campaigns for 4 publications
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Back-End Web Development · Responsive Web Design · Database Management System (DBMS) · Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
-Increased organic and paid traffic to website to new company records of 40% current traffic.
-Optimized Google ad spend by 30% by honing in on new customer profile information.
-Redesigned website fully with mid-funnel focus to cater to our primary visitor demographic.
positions.insights: Skills: Social Media Management · Advertising Campaigns · Search Engine Marketing (SEM) · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Research Analysis · Content Strategy · Landing Pages · B2B Marketing · Digital Marketing · Paid Search Campaigns · Wordpress Development · User Experience (UX) · Web Design · Business-to-Business (B2B)

positions.title: Digital Marketing Associate
positions.description:
-Define & implement a strategy for visibility and lead optimization through paid marketing and content marketing, using Google Analytics, Google Ads, and Google Merchant Center Suite, 
-Excel in client services and conversion consulting, resulting in a 96% client promoter score.
-Achieve newfound levels of lead conversion through rigorous data driven and analytical research.
-Collaborate in a fast-paced environment with multiple departments through Salesforce and other means.
positions.insights: Skills: Social Media Management · Advertising Campaigns · Shopify · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Facebook Ads · Research Analysis · Content Strategy · Landing Pages · B2B Marketing · Instagram Advertising · Paid Search Campaigns · Web Design

positions.title: Graphic Artist
positions.description:
-Develop high quality personalized product designs based on client's needs.
-Manage multiple projects at a time under pressure to meet daily and weekly deadlines.
-Supervise quality assurance for over 300 shipped products a day, and aid in any seasonal hire training as a senior member.

positions.title: Marketing Communications Specialist
positions.description:
-Spearhead and our new eBay e-commerce account, listings, and product marketing.
-Develop and execute competitive pricing and write clear, industry-relevant copy for over 2,000 products.
-Conduct photo shoots to update and produce visually stunning, high-quality edited photos of each product.
-Deliver weekly reports on progress with key milestones and consult new strategies to optimize sales.
